response.description: A diagnostic adapter for Self-EvolveRec that examines each trained NextItNet category model through the host ModelView interface. It reports measured metrics with definitions and constructs an interpretation prompt grounded in those measurements.
response.motivation: Make model diagnosis compatible with the actual sequential backbone while preventing unsupported conclusions about unavailable reviews, item attributes, or simulator traits. Model selection remains based on macro-average validation HR@10 across all four datasets.
response.implementation_notes: Retain DiagnosisProbe(view, device), run_full_diagnosis(train_loader), and diagnosis_interpreter_prompt(raw_diagnosis). Preserve view.model, item_emb, log2feats(sequence), predict_score(features, items), user_train, meta_data, and review_data interfaces. Consume batches shaped B x L containing (None, sequence, positive, negative), excluding padding from measurements. For left-padded histories, read the final nonpadding position rather than count-1. Use only observed histories, titles, descriptions, and timestamps; mark unsupported analyses unavailable. Preserve one independently trained NextItNet model/checkpoint per category and predictor consistency. No diagnostic results or performance gains are supplied in the description.
response.pseudocode:
class DiagnosisProbe:
  initialize(view, device)
  run_full_diagnosis(train_loader):
    save model training state
    put view.model in evaluation mode
    under no_grad:
      for (_, sequence, positive, negative) in train_loader:
        features = view.log2feats(sequence)
        identify valid sequence and target positions
        compute supported diagnostic measurements through ModelView
        accumulate measurements and sample counts
    restore model training state
    return {metrics: aggregated measurements,
            metric_definitions: definitions, populations, and limitations}

diagnosis_interpreter_prompt(raw_diagnosis):
  construct prompt from measured metrics and their definitions
  identify unavailable evidence explicitly
  request NextItNet-compatible hypotheses respecting the single-model constraint

originality.positive: Provides a task-specific interface connecting native diagnosis to NextItNet and the pinned benchmark.
originality.negative: Primarily an integration specification; it introduces no new diagnostic estimator or learning algorithm.

future_potential.positive: Could support evidence-based architecture and training changes through consistent, reproducible diagnostics.
future_potential.negative: Utility depends on probe design and validation; diagnostic correlations alone do not establish improvements in HR@10.

code_difficulty.positive: The required entry points, batch format, and compatibility interfaces are explicit.
code_difficulty.negative: Correct padding masks, feature alignment, measurement aggregation, and architecture-specific probes require care.
